plans.name: Advertising
items: Repeat and bot clicks aren't charged
Out of money — a pause, not a debt

faq.a: No. You top up your balance and spend it on clicks and AI copy. Whatever is left stays on your balance.

faq.q: How much does a click cost?
faq.a: Each placement sets its own price per click — you see it when creating a campaign, before launch.
The held amount returns to your balance in full — you can see it in your wallet history.

faq.q: What happens when my money runs out?
faq.a: Ads pause automatically and resume after you top up. Your balance never goes negative.

faq.q: Can I show these ads on my own website?
faq.a: Yes, we connect placements manually: write to us and we'll give you the banner embed code.
